Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Changes:
0: [adoption, redesign] Stage Layout Redesign for Pet Selection: Redesign the pet selection screen into a stage layout with a prominent mascot preview showcase. (why: Adoption has a 25.3% drop-off rate and median time of 89s, indicating users need a clearer, more inspiring pet selection experience.)
1: [home, redesign] Split Screen Interactive Setup & Render Stage Layout: Transforms the waiting screen into a split layout displaying progress alongside interactive mascot tips. (why: The waiting step (home) has a median completion time of 201s and mean of 2336s, leading to drop-off and missing pet complaints.)
2: [choose_path, reorder] Adoption Flow Reordering Before Cloud Account Sign In: Reorders onboarding sequence so users create and adopt their pet before reaching the account sign-in step. (why: Creating an emotional bond with the mascot prior to sign-in helps overcome onboarding drop-off across initial steps.)
3: [sign_in, hint] Account Recovery & Pet Synchronization Verification Hint: Adds an explicit account verification notice on sign-in assuring users that existing pets will be automatically synced. (why: 8 support emails reported pets missing or reset after signing in again.)
4: [adoption, layout] Custom Pet Photo Formatting Checklist: Updates the photo upload screen layout to a checklist format with clear photo quality guidelines. (why: 3 support emails reported custom pet generation failures or unexpected rendering outcomes.)
5: [finish, notification] Desktop Pet Launch System Tray Notification Toggle: Adds a notification toggle on the final intro screen letting users enable desktop ready alerts. (why: 3 support emails reported that the pet did not appear on desktop or users were unsure if the app opened.)
6: [home, wait_info] Pet Playbook Interactive Tip Carousel While Waiting: Embeds an interactive tip carousel component into the waiting screen that cycles through controls and features. (why: Long render times (mean 2336s) cause user drop-off and post-onboarding confusion regarding controls.)
7: [choose_path, layout] Spotlight Layout for Path Choice Selection: Changes the choose path screen layout to spotlight mode, highlighting key path features with mascot assets. (why: Choose path has a high mean time of 514s, showing that users hesitate when deciding their path.)
8: [finish, new_flow] Desktop Pet Mascot Interaction Sandbox Sub-Flow: Introduces an interactive mascot sound and animation preview sandbox component right before completing setup. (why: Finish conversion is 71.7% with high mean time (5815s), and users request better understanding of desktop interactions.)
